name: The Westin Cairo Golf Resort & Spa, Katameya Dunes
positioning: A golf and spa resort within a private community in New Cairo, built around a 27-hole championship course designed by Sir Nick Faldo and Brian Curley
best_for: Golfers who want to stay on a championship course near Cairo
Travelers who want a quiet spa resort base in New Cairo rather than the city center

facts.text: The resort is set within a private community in New Cairo, Egypt.
The resort is near Cairo International Airport.
A Golf Academy with extensive practice facilities supports the course.
Guest rooms and suites look out over the fairways.
The Westin Suite has a private balcony overlooking the gardens.
The Heavenly Spa has a steam room, a rain shower, a swimming pool and a whirlpool.
Spa treatments draw on Asian techniques such as traditional Chinese medicine and Thai massage.
Body scrubs and wraps use local organic products.
Maré Social is a taberna-style restaurant and bar inspired by chef Henrique Sá Pessoa, with indoor and outdoor seating overlooking the golf course.
Guests can plan visits to the Museum of Egyptian Antiquities and the Pyramids and Sphinx of Giza.

highlights.text: The resort has a 27-hole championship golf course designed by Sir Nick Faldo and Brian Curley.
The Presidential Suite has golf course views and a private pool.
Each treatment room at the Heavenly Spa has its own landscaping and personal shower.

considerations.text: The resort is in New Cairo, so the Pyramids and the Museum of Egyptian Antiquities are trips to plan rather than nearby walks; WhataHotel notes the secluded location outside central Cairo.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for the resort amenities.
